changelog: Live parcel status (Status\LiveStatus), off by default: with the Live status setting on and the shop's own 17TRACK API key (or CTRACKING_17TRACK_KEY), each tracking number added afterwards is registered with 17TRACK in the background (Action Scheduler ctracking_status_sync). Sent: the number, 17TRACK's carrier code (47 of the default carriers mapped; others detected) and <order ID>:<tracking ID>; nothing about the customer. The settings say so, and a privacy policy paragraph is suggested.

Webhook POST /wp-json/creative-tracking/v1/17track, accepting only pushes signed with the shop's key; late or replayed pushes don't roll a status back. A poll (ctracking_status_poll, every 12 hours) fetches what a missed push would have said.
Status\StatusProvider (filter ctracking_status_provider) with Status\SeventeenTrack, and Domain\SeventeenTrackFormat and Domain\ParcelStatus, pure and unit-tested.

Status shown on the order screen (with the carrier's words for staff), the orders list, a Status column in My Account and a Status line in the tracking emails; refusals ("Not followed: …") on the order screen. Status changes add an order note and fire ctracking_parcel_status_changed.
Emails customer_parcel_out_for_delivery, customer_parcel_delivered and customer_parcel_problem, each off until switched on, sent once per stage.
Order meta _ctracking_parcels and _ctracking_parcels_open, beside AST's items, which are unchanged.
Domain\Shipment has an optional status; the My Account and email tracking templates are version 1.4.0.
Uninstall and deactivation unschedule the live status jobs.
